channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 23
item.description:
229 development commits

Movement

  • Added a modern sprint system with in‑game settings for speed and stamina.

NPC & AI

  • Scientists now use a replay‑based aim system, fixed crouch‑hover issues, corrected rotation bugs, and improved door‑search targeting for more reliable combat behavior.

Animals & Livestock

  • Livestock can be renamed instantly without delay.
  • Cow models no longer display milk and the lead item appears correctly in the inventory wheel.
  • Dog commands were refined; dogs obey heel better and now run at player speed.

World & Environment

  • Sprinklers no longer wet players through floors or ceilings.
  • Fishing villages are placed farther from river mouths, avoiding unsuitable river terrain.
  • Overlap bugs fixed: masks use correct layers, junkpiles spawn after trees, and seagull groups no longer block on monument geometry.
  • Dropping items on thin surfaces (e.g., oil‑rig floors) works reliably without line‑of‑sight blockage.

Vehicles & Deployables

  • Cars now repel animals even when positioned directly on them, preventing animals from getting stuck.
  • Deployables placed near a split‑off base section now move with the new section instead of staying behind.

Missions & Endgame

  • Items stored in backpacks count toward mission objectives, and dispensers track progress correctly.
  • New team extraction: a freight lift in the exit test scene lets the whole squad leave together, with improved UI for escape hatch and balloon‑pad console.
  • Sleeping bags can be placed adjacent to each other and the respawn space check was removed, fixing stuck respawn issues.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Character creator now correctly retains each slot's selected underwear and prevents players from appearing naked when a body type lacks underwear parts.
  • Changing the body type instantly enables the facial hair tab, streamlining appearance customization.
  • Closing the premium shop window also closes the skin viewer, fixing a UI hang-up for premium users.
  • Mission item dispensers now reliably spawn items, fixing previous missing or duplicated rewards.
  • Item drops that were previously blocked by a bug now drop correctly, ensuring loot is obtainable.
  • Cave terrain blending no longer overlaps underground tunnel entrances or monument topology, improving map navigation and preventing impossible geometry.
  • Mortar aiming now matches player pitch without hand lag, improving accuracy.
  • M939 Truck now spawns at the Excavator Monument, providing a new vehicle option for players.
  • M939 Truck now spawns at Mining Quarry Monuments, expanding vehicle availability in quarry areas.
  • M939 Truck now spawns at the Gas Station Monument, adding another vehicle spawn point.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 22
item.description:
121 development commits

Map Layout

  • Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
  • The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.

AI & Reinforcements

  • Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.
  • Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.

Economy & Pricing

  • Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.
  • Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.

Inventory & Loot

  • Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
  • Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

Raid & Extraction

  • Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
  • Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
  • Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
  • Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 21
item.description:
68 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed lambs getting stuck and failing to follow a sprinting player when led.
  • Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.

Monuments & World

  • Monument guard NPCs now spread out, scale with monument size, and can stand on any floor.
  • Raid maps now spawn only whitelisted monuments, with each tier‑1 monument appearing once per map.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.
  • Bank balance is now always displayed on the Outpost screen for continuous fund monitoring.
